_note: Canonical short commands, written by the developer (not by the blind authors) after the first live test: 'come here', 'go there' and a bare 'breach' all fell below the threshold. The blind authors were told NOT to reuse the spec's wording, so the research data has almost no plain, frequent phrasings -- right for testing robustness, wrong for training a bot. These seed lines are added to TRAINING only (train_final.py --seeds, seed_check.py); they are never scored as test lines.
